chunks.text: OpenAI has countersued Apple over alleged trade secret theft. It filed on 27 November in a California federal court. OpenAI claims Apple obtained its device roadmap through a re-hired engineer. It alleges Apple threatened shared suppliers with lost contracts. OpenAI says around 400 specialists have moved from Apple. Apple sued first in July and rejects the allegations. Analysts say OpenAI is building AI devices with Jony Ive's team. Would Gulf companies choose OpenAI devices over iPhones?
